notes: Singapore: MOM handles Employment Act reports (Singpass sign-in) and, for migrant domestic workers, salary claims through its helpline. Channels read from the pages listed in sources on 2026-09-28.

channels.note: Report an Employment Act violation online (needs a Singpass account); the reporter's identity is kept confidential

MOM general enquiries, Mon-Fri 8.30am-5.30pm except public holidays
